body:
Offers Scribonia access to a local library during the Zarathian guild visit.

Recorded role and choices

Mirae appears as the Emerald Veil librarian during the August 2025 visit. When the visitors divide between different institutions, Mirae offers to escort Scribonia to a local library and then agrees to lead the way. The checked scene supports that introduction and offer of access. It does not make Mirae the same person as Míriel of the Emerald Veil, whose separate history and name are retained.
